Rapid Funding Group LLC v. Acme Widgets Inc

Filed March 2, 2026 in Montgomery County Court of Common Pleas.

The complaint states that Acme Widgets Inc. “failed to remit the daily payments due on February 3, February 10 and February 17, 2026” under the merchant cash advance agreement.

Rapid Funding Group seeks $310,000 plus fees.
